In three steps

What Itqan does

  1. Bring what you have

    Your record, your CV, your certificates, and answers to a few short questions. All of it counts, not one document.

  2. It reads the market for you

    Itqan checks everything you gave it against real, current openings and what those jobs actually ask for.

  3. See your fits and your path

    The jobs you fit today, each with its reason, and the shortest route to the role you want next.

Questions

Common questions

Is it really free?

Yes. Everything in Itqan is free. No plans, no trial period, and no payment at any point.

What do you need from me?

Your academic record, and if you have them, your CV, resume and certificates. Then a few short questions, up to ten, so Itqan understands what you are aiming for. The more it has, the sharper the fit.

Do you find real jobs, or just give advice?

Real openings that exist right now, matched to you, each with the reason it fits. Itqan does not promise you a job. It shows you where you have a real chance and where you do not.

What if nothing fits me yet?

Then you get a path. Itqan shows the role you are aiming for, what you already have toward it, and the shortest set of things to learn to get there.

Do I have to be Omani?

No. Itqan starts in Oman and reads Arabic and English documents, so graduates across the Gulf can use it.

Can I delete my data?

Yes, at any time. Deleting your account removes everything you gave Itqan and everything built from it.
